proposed_widenings.name: SpeciesTraitRecord
proposed_widenings.justification: UnitRecord has no species_trait kind. The surface schema (types.ts) defines SpellRecord | ClassFeatureRecord | MasteryRecord only. species_trait_root exists in the v4 taxonomy atom inventory but has no corresponding authored record type.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Naturally Stealthy is tagged kind: species_trait in the survey manifest but UnitRecord cannot represent it.

proposed_widenings.name: expand_action_eligibility
proposed_widenings.justification: The mechanic is a permanent passive modification of the precondition for taking an action (Hide). It neither activates nor consumes resources — it widens the set of circumstances under which the action is legally available. No v4 effect atom covers this shape. The closest candidates (grant_extra_action, restrict_action_set) are activation-scoped or restriction-scoped; neither models 'action X is permitted even when condition Y'.
proposed_widenings.evidence: You can take the Hide action even when you are obscured only by a creature that is at least one size larger than you.

notes: Two distinct gaps. Primary: UnitRecord lacks a species_trait kind — cannot typecheck or trace without it. Secondary: even within a hypothetical passive species-trait family, the mechanic is an action-eligibility precondition expansion with no analog in the current atom inventory. The Hide action's standard eligibility requires full obscurement; this trait relaxes that requirement to 'a larger creature is between you and the observer.' This is purely passive and permanent — no cost, no roll, no save, no reset. It does not fit any existing mechanics family.
